name: cua-hard/dad-visits-airbnb-settlement
description: Settle October's family Airbnb stays: reconcile the Bookings sheet against Airbnb trips/receipts and the siblings' emails (cancellation with partial refund, shortened and moved stays, a missing stay, a superseded receipt), apply the split rules from a Gmail thread including an October amendment, record the Settlement rows, email the siblings, and hand over a rerunnable settle.py that is replayed on hidden months.
